statement_summary: Qualified Individual designated in writing
Annual written risk assessment using SP 800-30 and after material changes
Annual written Qualified Individual report to the Board of Managers
Exceptions; written Qualified Individual approval for encryption or MFA alternatives
Vendor security review before access; contract safeguards; annual reassessment; FERPA school-official terms
Annual control assessment; scans every six months; annual penetration test
Sanctions for policy violations
Change management for SIS, FAMS, identity, integration, cloud, and firewall changes
Security training for IT staff; qualified personnel
Unique named accounts; no shared accounts
Least privilege tied to legitimate educational interest
MFA for any individual accessing any information system, including the servicer and students
Same-day access removal, including adjunct contract ends
Semiannual access reviews; quarterly for privileged, servicer, and service accounts
Break-glass administrator accounts
Unique local admin passwords; service account secrets in key management
MFA and out-of-band confirmation for student refund bank changes
Separation of awarding and disbursing roles
Physical access to the records room and server closet
Written incident response plan and ransomware runbook
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; providers within 72 hours
Incident log in the ticketing system
Documented notification event and discovery date determinations
Meet FSA, FTC, and Florida notification deadlines

Lessons learned and remediation into the POA&M; plan revision
Encrypt Restricted information at rest and in transit
Customer information data map
FAFSA data and federal tax information used only for aid administration
Secure disposal within two years of last use unless retention is required
Isolated immutable backups restore-tested quarterly
Retention schedule reviewed annually
Record every disclosure of education records in the SIS
Annual training updated to current risks; quarterly phishing exercises
Approved AI tools only; early-alert use limited to the pilot
Look up records only with a job need; access logged and reviewed
Lab isolation and single-purpose SAIG workstations
